chunks.title: Getting Started
chunks.content:
Essential navigation and dashboard overview
Topics: Dashboard Overview; Navigation & Sidebar

chunks.title: Dashboard Overview
chunks.content:
The main dashboard provides a comprehensive view of your property data with key performance indicators (KPIs), charts, and recent activity.
Features: Real-time data updates across all modules; Interactive charts and visualizations; Quick access to all sections via sidebar navigation; Notification center for alerts and updates

chunks.title: Navigation & Sidebar
chunks.content:
Use the collapsible sidebar to navigate between different sections. The active page is highlighted for easy reference.
Features: Collapsible sidebar for more screen space; Quick search functionality (Ctrl/⌘ + K); User profile and settings access; Role-based menu visibility

chunks.title: Client Management
chunks.content:
Comprehensive CRM for managing investor clients
Topics: Client Tracker; Client Details & Financials; Client Notes & Reminders; Client Tags & Segmentation; Portfolio Analysis Reports

chunks.title: Client Tracker
chunks.content:
The Client Tracker is your central hub for managing all client relationships, tracking their investment journey, and maintaining detailed records.
Features: Client cards with key financial summaries; Pipeline stage tracking for each client; Favorite clients for quick access; Advanced filtering by status, tags, and activity; Bulk actions for efficient management
Steps: 1. Navigate to "Client Tracker" in the sidebar 2. Use the search bar to find specific clients 3. Click on a client card to view full details 4. Use tabs to navigate between Personal, Employment, Financials, Properties, Emails, Notes, and Reports 5. Update client information directly in the modal

chunks.title: Client Details & Financials
chunks.content:
Each client profile contains comprehensive financial information for borrowing capacity and portfolio analysis.
Features: Personal and employment details; Income sources with multiple entry types; Expense tracking by category; Assets and liabilities management; Property portfolio overview; Borrowing capacity calculations

chunks.title: Client Notes & Reminders
chunks.content:
Keep detailed notes and set reminders for follow-ups and important dates.
Features: Rich text notes with timestamps; Voice note recording capability; Reminder scheduling with priority levels; Activity timeline showing all interactions

chunks.title: Client Tags & Segmentation
chunks.content:
Organize clients with custom tags for better segmentation and targeting.
Features: Create custom colored tags; Assign multiple tags per client; Filter clients by tag combinations; Bulk tag assignment

chunks.title: Portfolio Analysis Reports
chunks.content:
Generate comprehensive portfolio health reports for your clients.
Features: Overall portfolio health scoring; Property-by-property breakdown; Equity and cashflow analysis; LVR and yield calculations; PDF export with professional formatting
Steps: 1. Open a client's details modal 2. Navigate to the "Reports" tab 3. Click "Generate Portfolio Analysis" 4. Wait for the AI to analyze all properties 5. Download the PDF report

chunks.title: Email Copilot
chunks.content:
AI-powered email management and automation
Topics: Email Overview; Managing Emails; Linking Emails to Clients; Email Actions

chunks.title: Email Overview
chunks.content:
The Email Copilot centralizes all client communications with AI-powered features for drafting, summarizing, and managing emails.
Features: Unified inbox for admin and personal mailboxes; AI-generated email summaries; Smart draft replies with context awareness; Urgency detection and prioritization; Client linking for organized communications

chunks.title: Managing Emails
chunks.content:
Process and organize incoming emails efficiently with AI assistance.
Steps: 1. Navigate to "Email Copilot" in the sidebar 2. View inbox organized by urgency and status 3. Click on an email to see full content and AI summary 4. Use "Generate AI Reply" for smart draft responses 5. Link emails to specific clients for tracking 6. Mark emails as processed when complete

chunks.title: Linking Emails to Clients
chunks.content:
Associate email threads with specific clients for organized tracking.
Features: Search and select clients from the dropdown; View all linked emails in client details; Track communication history per client; Quick access from both Email Copilot and Client Tracker

chunks.title: Email Actions
chunks.content:
Take action on emails directly from the copilot interface.
Features: Generate AI-powered reply drafts; Mark as processed/pending/follow-up; Set urgency levels (low, normal, high, critical); Compose and send replies with signature; Archive completed conversations

chunks.title: Aurixa Intelligence Hub (AI Chat)
chunks.content:
AI-powered assistant for property report analysis
Topics: AI Chat Overview; Using the AI Chat; Conversation Management; Advanced Features

chunks.title: AI Chat Overview
chunks.content:
The Aurixa Intelligence Hub feature allows you to have natural conversations with an AI assistant that has access to your property reports and market data.
Features: Natural language queries about properties; Context-aware responses using your report data; Multi-turn conversations with memory; PDF document attachment and analysis; Voice message input support

chunks.title: Using the AI Chat
chunks.content:
Ask questions about properties, market trends, and investment analysis.
Steps: 1. Navigate to "Aurixa Intelligence Hub" in the sidebar 2. Select reports from the sidebar to provide context 3. Type your question in the message input 4. Use voice recording for hands-free input 5. Review AI responses with source citations 6. Follow up with clarifying questions
Tips: Attach specific reports for more accurate answers; Ask comparative questions across multiple properties; Request summaries of complex report sections; Use follow-up suggestions for deeper analysis

chunks.title: Conversation Management
chunks.content:
Organize and manage your AI chat history.
Features: Pin important conversations; Tag conversations by topic; Search conversation history (⌘/Ctrl + K); Export conversations as PDF or text; Start new chats (⌘/Ctrl + N)

chunks.title: Advanced Features
chunks.content:
Power user features for enhanced productivity.
Features: Full-screen mode (⌘/Ctrl + Enter); Text-to-speech for responses; Message reactions for feedback; Auto-summarize long responses; Theme customization; Accessibility settings

chunks.title: Property Management
chunks.content:
View and manage property listings
Topics: Property Marketplace; Property Filters; Property Details

chunks.title: Property Marketplace
chunks.content:
View and manage all property listings with advanced filtering and search capabilities.
Features: Search by address, suburb, or postcode; Filter by property type, price range, and status; View detailed property information; Generate investment reports for individual properties; Compare multiple properties side-by-side

chunks.title: Property Filters
chunks.content:
Use filters to narrow down properties based on your criteria.
Features: State and suburb filtering; Property type selection (house, unit, land, etc.); Price range filtering with min/max; Status filtering (active, pending, sold, withdrawn); Save filter presets for quick access

chunks.title: Property Details
chunks.content:
View comprehensive information about each property.
Features: Property specifications and features; Price history and market comparison; Location insights and amenities; Agent and agency information; Quick report generation buttons

chunks.title: Cash Flow Analysis
chunks.content:
Detailed property cash flow modeling
Topics: Cash Flow Calculator; Scenario Comparison

chunks.title: Cash Flow Calculator
chunks.content:
Model the cash flow of investment properties with detailed income and expense projections.
Features: Rental income projections; Operating expense calculations; Loan repayment modeling; Tax benefit analysis; Net cash flow visualization

chunks.title: Scenario Comparison
chunks.content:
Compare different investment scenarios side-by-side.
Features: Multiple property comparison; Interest rate sensitivity analysis; Occupancy rate impact modeling; Growth rate projections; Export comparison reports

chunks.title: Borrowing Capacity
chunks.content:
Calculate client borrowing power
Topics: Capacity Calculator; Conservative Mode; Saving Assessments

chunks.title: Capacity Calculator
chunks.content:
Calculate borrowing capacity based on income, expenses, and existing commitments using bank-approved methodologies.
Features: Gross and net income calculation; Living expense modeling (HEM/declared); Existing commitment factoring; Buffer rate application; Serviceability assessment

chunks.title: Conservative Mode
chunks.content:
Apply stricter lending criteria for more realistic capacity estimates.
Features: $1,000/mo minimum surplus floor; $1,500 residual income floor; 85% surplus utilization; 6x DTI (debt-to-income) cap; Lender-specific adjustments
Tips: Use Conservative Mode for client-facing quotes; Standard mode shows theoretical maximum; Compare both modes to set expectations

chunks.title: Saving Assessments
chunks.content:
Save borrowing capacity assessments to client profiles.
Steps: 1. Complete the borrowing capacity calculation 2. Review the results and recommendations 3. Click "Save to Client" button 4. Select the client from the dropdown 5. Access saved assessments from client details

chunks.title: Call Logs

AI-powered call recording and analysis
Topics: Call Management; Call Analysis; Alert Rules

chunks.title: Call Management
chunks.content:
Track and analyze all client calls with AI-powered transcription and insights.
Features: Automatic call recording; AI transcription of conversations; Sentiment analysis; Key topic extraction; Call duration and status tracking

chunks.title: Call Analysis
chunks.content:
Extract insights from recorded calls.
Features: Full transcript review; Speaker identification; Action item extraction; Follow-up task creation; Client linking for context

chunks.title: Alert Rules
chunks.content:
Set up automated alerts based on call content or metrics.
Features: Keyword-based triggers; Duration thresholds; Sentiment-based alerts; Custom notification rules; Team notification routing

chunks.title: Auto Report Generation

Automated report generation and workflows

chunks.title: Auto-Report Switches
chunks.content:
Configure automated report generation based on property criteria.
Features: Criteria-based triggers (price, location, type); Priority ordering for multiple switches; Enable/disable individual switches; Generation logging and history; Master toggle for all automation
Steps: 1. Navigate to "Auto Report Generation" in the sidebar 2. Click "Add Switch" to create a new automation 3. Configure trigger criteria (state, price range, property type) 4. Set priority order for switch evaluation 5. Enable the switch and master toggle 6. Monitor generation logs for activity

chunks.title: Generation Logs
chunks.content:
View history of all automated report generations.
Features: Success/failure status for each generation; Property details and switch that triggered; Error messages for troubleshooting; Timestamp and duration tracking; Link to generated reports

chunks.title: Reports & Analytics

Investment reports and data visualization

chunks.title: Investment Report Generation
chunks.content:
Create comprehensive property investment analysis reports with AI-powered insights.
Features: 13-section comprehensive analysis; Market KPIs and pricing trends; Demographics and demand analysis; Risk assessment (flood, bushfire, crime); Financial projections and scenarios; Investment scoring (0-100)
Steps: 1. Go to "Property Marketplace" and find your target property 2. Click "Generate Report" on the property card 3. Choose analysis mode (Address/Postcode/State) 4. Configure financial assumptions 5. Wait for AI analysis (2-5 minutes) 6. Review and download the report

chunks.title: Generated Reports
chunks.content:
Access and manage all your generated investment reports.
Features: Report library with search and filters; PDF download and sharing; Report versioning history; Bookmarking for quick access; Usage analytics

chunks.title: Charts & Visualization
chunks.content:
Create custom charts for market analysis and presentations.
Features: Multiple chart types (bar, line, pie, scatter); Custom data filtering and grouping; Export as images or PDFs; Real-time data updates; Comparative analysis tools

chunks.title: Portfolio Reports
chunks.content:
Generate portfolio-level analysis across multiple properties.
Features: Multi-property health scoring; Diversification analysis; Combined cash flow projections; Risk distribution overview; Client-ready PDF exports

Steps: 1. Navigate to "Data Import" in the sidebar 2. Download the import template 3. Fill in your data following the template format 4. Upload the completed spreadsheet 5. Review validation results 6. Confirm and complete the import

chunks.title: Client Detail Forms
chunks.content:
Import client data from client detail form submissions.
Features: Automatic form parsing; Client profile creation; Income and expense extraction; Property detail import; Document attachment linking

Steps: 1. Navigate to "Templates" in the sidebar 2. Select the "AI Structure" tab 3. Click "Upload Template" and select your reference PDF 4. Configure category and priority settings 5. Save to enable for report generation

chunks.title: PDF Layout Templates

HTML/CSS templates that control the visual layout and styling of generated PDF reports.
Features: Custom header and footer designs; Page layout configurations; Font and color scheme settings; Section ordering and visibility

chunks.title: Integration Overview
chunks.content:
Connect and manage external services for enhanced functionality.
Features: Airtable for property listings; Vapi for voice AI and call handling; GoHighLevel for CRM sync; OpenAI for AI analysis; Microsoft/Outlook for email; Twilio for SMS communications; Make.com for workflow automation

chunks.title: Configuring Integrations
chunks.content:
Set up API keys and credentials for each service.
Steps: 1. Navigate to "Integrations" in the sidebar 2. Select the integration you want to configure 3. Enter the required API keys or credentials 4. Click "Save" to store the configuration 5. Use "Sync to Supabase" to enable for edge functions 6. Verify connection status shows "Configured"
Tips: Keep API keys secure and never share them; Use the visibility toggle to verify key values; Check documentation links for each service; Refresh Supabase status after syncing

chunks.title: Supabase Secrets
chunks.content:
Manage secrets for edge function access.
Features: Sync API keys to Supabase secrets; Status indicators for each integration; Partial configuration warnings; One-click refresh for status

Features: Property type categorization; Build year and purchase date tracking; Finish standard classification; City-based regional data; 10-year depreciation projections

chunks.title: Adding Comparables
chunks.content:
Add new depreciation comparable data to the system.
Steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Depreciation Comps 2. Click "Add New" to create a manual entry 3. Fill in property details and depreciation values 4. Or use CSV upload for bulk imports 5. Review and save the data

chunks.title: CSV Import
chunks.content:
Bulk import depreciation data from spreadsheets.
Features: Template download for correct formatting; Column mapping validation; Preview before import; Error reporting for invalid rows
Tips: Download the template first to ensure correct format; Include all 10 years of depreciation values; Specify property type and finish standard; Review preview before confirming import

chunks.title: Depreciation Estimator

Generate depreciation estimates based on property characteristics.
Features: Match against comparable properties; Confidence scoring; Plant & Equipment (P&E) estimates; Division 40/43 calculations

chunks.title: Pipeline Overview
chunks.content:
The Deal Pipeline provides a Kanban-style board to track every property deal through its lifecycle stages.
Features: Kanban board with drag-and-drop stage progression; Deal stages: Lead, Qualified, Proposal, Negotiation, Under Contract, Settlement, Completed; Deal value and commission tracking; Client and property linking; Assigned team member per deal; Build progress payment tracking for construction deals
Steps: 1. Navigate to "Deal Pipeline" in the sidebar 2. Click "Add Deal" to create a new deal 3. Link the deal to a client and property 4. Drag deals between stages as they progress 5. Track commissions and builder invoices within each deal

chunks.title: Build Progress Payments

Track construction stage payments and builder invoices for build deals.
Features: Stage-by-stage payment tracking (Slab, Frame, Lock-up, etc.); Builder invoice receipt and submission tracking; Funds released and paid-to-builder status; Commission trigger identification per stage; Lender submission tracking

chunks.title: Compliance Home
chunks.content:
The AML workspace opens on Compliance Home, which summarises where obligations stand right now: total cases, cases opened recently, cases awaiting a decision, open alerts, unprocessed events and periodic reviews falling due.
Features: Metric tiles link straight through to the filtered list behind them; My Queue shows only the cases assigned to you; Regulatory & Assurance header flags anything overdue; Legacy alias banner appears where an older workspace name is still in use
Tips: Start at Compliance Home rather than Cases — the tiles surface what is blocked, which a raw case list does not.

chunks.title: Cases & the Case Workspace
chunks.content:
A case tracks one subject through customer due diligence. Cases move through a defined lifecycle and cannot skip states — the allowed transitions are enforced server-side, not just in the UI.
Features: Statuses: draft, KYC in progress, KYC complete, EDD required, under review, escalated to MLRO, cleared, blocked, closed; Risk ratings: low, medium, high, prohibited; Case workspace tabs cover verification, ownership and control, structures, documents and events; Every write appends to a per-case event log with a SHA-256 hash chain, so tampering is detectable
Steps: 1. Open Cases and create a case against the subject 2. Complete identity verification in the Verification tab 3. Record ownership and control for non-individual subjects 4. Move the case to under review once KYC is complete 5. Escalate to the MLRO where enhanced due diligence is required
Tips: The event log is append-only. Correcting a mistake means adding a correcting event, not editing history.

chunks.title: Verification & Screening
chunks.content:
Verification captures identity evidence for a subject. Screening checks subjects against PEP and sanctions sources and records the result against the case.
Features: Identity checks recorded per subject with provider results retained; PEP and sanctions hits raise an event on the case; Screening results are versioned so a later re-screen does not overwrite the earlier decision; Step-up authentication is required before sensitive actions
Tips: A step-up prompt is not an error. Sensitive AML actions deliberately re-verify who you are before proceeding.

chunks.title: Risk, Transactions & Monitoring
chunks.content:
Risk scores a subject from the factors recorded against them. Transaction Compliance and Monitoring watch activity for patterns that need review.
Features: Risk ratings can be re-scored as new information arrives, with each change logged; Transaction monitoring raises alerts against thresholds and rules; Unprocessed events queue surfaces anything the engine has not yet triaged; Counterparty due diligence covers the other side of a transaction

chunks.title: Investigations & EDD
chunks.content:
Where a case needs enhanced due diligence, Investigations holds the working record: what was asked, what was received and what was concluded.
Features: EDD notes attach to the case event chain; MLRO decisions are recorded as their own event category; Investigations can be escalated or returned to standard review

chunks.title: AUSTRAC Hub & Reporting
chunks.content:
The AUSTRAC Hub prepares and tracks regulatory reports. Reports are generated from case data rather than re-keyed.
Features: Report drafts built from the underlying case record; Submission status tracked per report; Records & Retention governs how long material is kept
Tips: Check Records & Privacy before deleting anything — retention obligations outlast a closed case.

chunks.title: Governance, Intake & Launch Operations
chunks.content:
Governance holds the compliance contacts and organisational settings. Intake Queue is where new subjects arrive before a case is opened. Launch Operations covers rollout and cutover activity.
Features: Governance & Contacts records the MLRO and responsible officers; Intake Queue triages inbound subjects into cases; Organisation Settings configure thresholds and provider modes; Platform Administration covers integration health and version cutover

chunks.title: Roles & Access
chunks.content:
AML access is separate from general dashboard permission. Reads require an AML role; writes require the specific role for that action, and the service enforces this in code as well as through row-level security.
Features: Analyst, reviewer and MLRO roles carry different write permissions; MLRO-only event categories cannot be written by an analyst; Restricted AML data is hidden entirely from users without a role

chunks.title: Finance Portal
chunks.content:
Broker and finance partner workspace, referrals and commissions
Topics: Portal Overview; Purchase Files; Earnings & Commissions; Administering the Portal

chunks.title: Portal Overview
chunks.content:
The Finance Portal is a separate login for finance partners. They see only the clients and files shared with them, never your whole book.
Features: Dashboard summarising active files and outstanding actions; Clients list scoped to assigned relationships; Client inbox and messaging with the referring adviser; Insights and lender intelligence for the partner

chunks.title: Purchase Files
chunks.content:
A purchase file is the unit of work in the portal: one client purchase, tracked from referral through to settlement.
Features: File detail view with documents, milestones and messages; Pipeline view showing where every file sits; AML case snapshot surfaces compliance status against the file

chunks.title: Earnings & Commissions
chunks.content:
Earnings track what a partner has been paid and what is pending. Commission structures and clawbacks are administered from the staff side.
Features: Earnings statement per partner; Commission register with clawback tracking; Bulk import for historical commission data

chunks.title: Administering the Portal
chunks.content:
Staff manage the portal from Admin → Finance Portal: inviting contacts, assigning clients, and reviewing activity.
Features: Analytics, compliance and health panels for portal operations; Activity log per partner; Staff-side message view mirroring the partner inbox
Steps: 1. Invite a finance contact from Admin → Finance Portal 2. Assign clients or purchase files to the contact 3. Monitor activity and compliance from the admin panels

chunks.title: Solicitor Portal
chunks.content:
Conveyancing partner workspace and legal matters
Topics: Matters; Client Legal Workspace; Onboarding a Solicitor

chunks.title: Matters
chunks.content:
A matter is a legal file attached to a client purchase. Solicitors log in separately and see only the matters assigned to them.
Features: Matters list with status and key dates; Matter detail holding documents, correspondence and milestones; Pipeline view across all assigned matters

chunks.title: Client Legal Workspace
chunks.content:
On the staff side, the legal workspace on a client shows the matter without leaving the client record.
Features: Legal tab on the client with matter status; Document exchange with the solicitor; Security settings governing what the partner can see

chunks.title: Onboarding a Solicitor
chunks.content:
Solicitors are invited from Admin → Solicitor Portal and complete their own onboarding, including accepting terms.
Steps: 1. Send an invite from Admin → Solicitor Portal 2. The solicitor accepts, sets a password and agrees to terms 3. Assign matters to the onboarded firm

chunks.title: Builder Portal
chunks.content:
Builder partner workspace and organisation access
Topics: Builder Access; Administering Builders

chunks.title: Builder Access
chunks.content:
Builders log in through their own portal and can belong to more than one organisation, selecting which they are acting for.
Features: Separate builder login and password reset flow; Organisation selection where a builder works across entities; Builder settings and terms acceptance

chunks.title: Administering Builders
chunks.content:
Staff manage builder access from Admin → Builder Portal: invitations, organisation membership and activity review.
Steps: 1. Invite the builder from Admin → Builder Portal 2. Assign them to one or more organisations 3. Review activity from the admin panel

chunks.title: Commercial & Industrial
chunks.content:
Non-residential property analysis and calculators
Topics: Commercial Properties; Industrial Properties; Property Calculators

chunks.title: Commercial Properties
chunks.content:
Commercial listings are analysed separately from residential because the drivers differ — yield, lease terms and outgoings rather than rental yield alone.
Features: Commercial property list with filtering; Property detail with commercial-specific metrics; Scenario modelling through the commercial calculators

chunks.title: Industrial Properties
chunks.content:
Industrial stock has its own list and detail view, with calculators tuned to industrial metrics.
Features: Industrial property list and detail; Industrial calculators for site and building metrics

chunks.title: Property Calculators
chunks.content:
The calculators page collects the standalone tools for modelling a purchase without creating a full report.
Tips: Use the calculators for a quick sanity check; use a full report when the numbers need to be shared or retained.

chunks.title: Market News Feed
chunks.content:
Curated market intelligence, digests and shareable Q&A
Topics: Market Feed; Market Q&A; Digests & Subscriptions

chunks.title: Market Feed
chunks.content:
Market News Feed ingests configured sources, scores each item for relevance, and surfaces what matters rather than everything published.
Features: Relevance and confidence thresholds filter low-value items; Source list is administered from the Market Sources dialog; Public feed URL for embedding elsewhere

chunks.title: Market Q&A
chunks.content:
Ask questions against the ingested market material and get an answer grounded in the sources, with the material it drew on.
Features: Voice input for asking questions hands-free; Answers can be shared via a tokenised public link; Quality reporting on answers from the admin side

chunks.title: Digests & Subscriptions
chunks.content:
Digests bundle recent market movement on a schedule. Subscriptions control who receives them.
Features: Scheduled digest generation; Per-recipient subscription management; Shared answers accessible without a login via their token

chunks.title: Model Hub
chunks.content:
AI model selection, availability and cost
Topics: Browsing Models; Assigning Models to Agents

chunks.title: Browsing Models
chunks.content:
Model Hub lists the AI models available through the routed provider, with their pricing and context limits, so a model can be chosen on cost as well as capability.
Features: Model table with pricing per million tokens and context window; Card view for comparing candidates; Availability checked against the provider rather than assumed

chunks.title: Assigning Models to Agents
chunks.content:
Different jobs justify different models. Assignments map an agent key to a model, so report generation and quick chat need not share one.
Tips: Check API Usage after changing an assignment — a more capable model changes cost per report, not just quality.

chunks.title: Game Plan
chunks.content:
Client strategy plans, phases and assigned tasks
Topics: Building a Plan; Assigned Tasks

chunks.title: Building a Plan
chunks.content:
A game plan sets out a client strategy as phases over a timeline, each holding the tasks that move it forward.
Features: Phases with their own dates and rich-text detail; Timeline bar showing the plan at a glance; Tasks assigned to team members with due dates
Steps: 1. Create a plan against the client 2. Add phases covering each stage of the strategy 3. Add tasks to each phase and assign owners

chunks.title: Assigned Tasks
chunks.content: The assigned tasks view collects everything allocated to you across every plan, so nothing depends on remembering which client it belonged to.

chunks.title: Partner Network
chunks.content:
Partner agreements, compliance and referrals
Topics: Partner Agreements; Partner Compliance; Partner Referrals

chunks.title: Partner Agreements
chunks.content:
Agreements record the terms a partner operates under, including when an agreement is terminated and why.
Features: Agreement register per partner; Termination dialog capturing the reason and effective date

chunks.title: Partner Compliance
chunks.content:
Compliance tracks partner obligations, including privacy incidents raised against a partner.
Features: Privacy incident logging with follow-up; Compliance status per partner

chunks.title: Partner Referrals
chunks.content:
Referrals move a client between your business and a partner, with consent captured explicitly before anything is shared.
Features: Referral dialog and detail sheet; Consent panel recording what the client agreed to share; Loan writer assignment and undertakings; Public consent page reachable by token, so a client can consent without an account
Tips: Consent is recorded per referral. Re-referring the same client later asks again rather than reusing the earlier consent.

chunks.title: Quantitative Reports
chunks.content:
Listings-level market analytics
Topics: Reporting Command Centre

chunks.title: Reporting Command Centre
chunks.content:
Quantitative reports aggregate listing data into market-level views — volumes, pricing and distribution by suburb.
Features: Totals for listings, average price and unique suburbs; Listings by suburb breakdown; Recent listings feed; Individual report detail views

chunks.title: PDF Import & Report Ingestion
chunks.content:
Importing existing reports and monitoring the ingestion engine
Topics: Importing Reports; Engine Administration

chunks.title: Importing Reports
chunks.content:
Existing PDF reports can be ingested so their content becomes searchable and reusable rather than sitting as a flat file.
Features: Client report import with extraction into structured data; Import quality scoring per document

chunks.title: Engine Administration
chunks.content:
The ingestion engine is administered from a set of admin pages, because extraction quality drifts as source documents change.
Features: Diagnostics for a single import, showing what was extracted and what failed; Monitoring across all imports for failure rate and throughput; Golden regression suite catching quality regressions before they ship; Retention settings governing how long imported source files are kept
Tips: Check Diagnostics before re-importing a failed document — a repeat import of an unreadable file fails the same way.

chunks.title: Billing & Usage
chunks.content:
Plan, token balance, invoices and payment methods
Topics: Token Balance; Plan & Invoices; Report Cost

chunks.title: Token Balance
chunks.content:
Report generation and AI features consume tokens drawn from your balance. The balance combines your plan allowance with any top-up packs bought on top.
Features: Balance pill visible while working; Cost estimate shown before an expensive action runs; Out-of-tokens banner when the balance will not cover the next action; Token event history explaining what each deduction paid for
Tips: Allowance and top-ups share one balance and are spent soonest-to-expire first, so an allowance is always consumed before a pack you bought.

chunks.title: Plan & Invoices
chunks.content:
Your plan determines which modules are available. Changing plan takes effect against your workspace and is reflected in a banner when it happens.
Features: Invoice history with downloadable records; Payment method management; Plan change banner confirming what changed

chunks.title: Report Cost
chunks.content: Each report carries a cost badge so the token price is visible before generating, not discovered afterwards.

chunks.title: Lenders & Lender Intelligence
chunks.content:
Lender policies, rates and comparison
Topics: Lender Register; Lender Intelligence

chunks.title: Lender Register
chunks.content:
The lender list holds the institutions you work with and the policy detail that affects borrowing capacity.
Features: Lender records with policy attributes; Comparison across lenders for a given scenario

chunks.title: Lender Intelligence
chunks.content:
Lender intelligence surfaces rate and policy movement, including data drawn from the CDR lending rates service.
Tips: Borrowing capacity results depend on lender policy. A capacity figure is only as current as the lender record behind it.

chunks.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
chunks.content:
Quick actions for power users
Topics: Global Shortcuts; Aurixa Intelligence Hub Shortcuts; Calendar Shortcuts

chunks.title: Global Shortcuts
chunks.content:
Shortcuts available throughout the application.
Shortcut: ⌘/Ctrl+K — Open search / history search
Shortcut: ⌘/Ctrl+N — New chat (in Aurixa Intelligence Hub)
Shortcut: ⌘/Ctrl+/ — Focus message input
Shortcut: Esc — Close dialogs / Exit full screen

chunks.title: Aurixa Intelligence Hub Shortcuts
chunks.content:
Shortcuts specific to the AI chat interface.
Shortcut: ⌘/Ctrl+⇧+C — Copy last response
Shortcut: ⌘/Ctrl+J — Scroll to bottom
Shortcut: ⌘/Ctrl+B — Toggle reports panel
Shortcut: ⌘/Ctrl+Enter — Toggle full screen
Shortcut: Enter — Send message
Shortcut: Shift+Enter — New line in message

chunks.title: Calendar Shortcuts
chunks.content:
Shortcuts for calendar navigation.
Shortcut: T — Go to today
Shortcut: ←+→ — Navigate periods
Shortcut: D — Day view
Shortcut: W — Week view
Shortcut: M — Month view
Shortcut: ? — Show shortcuts help

chunks.title: Troubleshooting
chunks.content:
Common issues and solutions
Topics: Report Generation Issues; Data Sync Issues; Email Copilot Issues; Best Practices

chunks.title: Report Generation Issues
chunks.content:
Solutions for common report generation problems.
Tips: If "Data Unavailable" appears, try a broader analysis mode (Address → Postcode → State); Complex analysis can take 3-7 minutes depending on data availability; Avoid generating multiple reports simultaneously; Check your internet connection for timeouts; Verify property addresses are correctly formatted

chunks.title: Data Sync Issues
chunks.content:
Troubleshooting data synchronization problems.
Tips: Check the Monitoring page for API health status; Manual sync can be triggered from Sources page; Allow up to 24 hours for market data updates; Contact support if sync failures persist

chunks.title: Email Copilot Issues
chunks.content:
Solutions for email-related problems.
Tips: Verify email credentials in Settings; Check mailbox permissions for OAuth connections; AI summaries require email body content; Refresh the page if emails aren't loading

chunks.title: Best Practices
chunks.content:
Tips for optimal system usage.
Tips: Use complete addresses with suburb, state, and postcode; Generate reports after major market events for current data; Use consistent financial assumptions when comparing properties; Regularly review and update client information; Export important reports for offline access

chunks.title: Quick Tips
chunks.content:
Tip 1: Use ⌘/Ctrl + K to quickly search across the application
Tip 2: Combine multiple filters for precise property and client searches
Tip 3: Download reports in PDF format for offline viewing and sharing
Tip 4: Click on any property card to view detailed information and generate reports
Tip 5: Use the Overview dashboard for a quick snapshot of portfolio performance
Tip 6: Ask the Aurixa Intelligence Hub AI natural language questions about your properties

chunks.title: Property Status Guide
chunks.content:
Active: Property is currently listed and available
Pending: Property has an offer pending or under contract
Sold: Property has been successfully sold
Withdrawn: Property has been removed from the market
Expired: Listing has expired and needs renewal

chunks.title: Need Help?
chunks.content:
Support option 1: Check the Settings page for configuration options
Support option 2: Use the Aurixa Intelligence Hub AI to ask questions about features
Support option 3: Review Error Logs for troubleshooting system issues
Support option 4: Contact your system administrator for technical support
